summary: Build a modern, clean, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimized one-page website for Shree Ram Holidays – Tour & Travel Company (Katra, J&K) focused on high booking conversion for tours and taxi services.
architectural_notes: Single-page layout with sections in the specified order and repeated clear CTAs (Call Now, WhatsApp Booking, Book Now).
SEO-first implementation: keyword targeting (e.g., Katra Taxi Service, Vaishno Devi Tour Package, Best Travel Agency in Katra, Katra to Kashmir Taxi), fast loading, mobile-friendly responsive design.
Contact section must include full business address, phone/WhatsApp, email, and Google Map embed.
Support custom domain mapping (GoDaddy DNS + IC domain verification) once the live .icp0.io canister URL is available.
known_issues: Live canister URL (.icp0.io) not yet available / draft app expired, blocking custom domain DNS setup.

existing_features.title: Build a modern, clean, mobile-responsive one-page website for the Indian travel agency “Maa Bhagwati Tour And Travel” with conversion-focused CTAs and the following sections rendered in this exact order: (1) Hero, (2) About Us, (3) Tour Packages, (4) Taxi & Travel Services, (5) Vehicle Fleet, (6) Why Choose Us, (7) Popular Routes, (8) Customer Reviews, (9) Travel Gallery, (10) Contact.

Implement the Hero section content and CTAs: headline that includes “Best Katra Taxi Service & Tour Packages”, a subheading mentioning Vaishno Devi, Kashmir, Himachal, and Leh Ladakh, a prominent “Call Now” button linking to tel:+919906109003, a prominent “WhatsApp Booking” button linking to https://wa.me/919906109003, and a travel-themed background image.
Implement the About Us section describing the business as a trusted local Katra travel agency with experienced drivers, safe and affordable travel, and a focus on families and pilgrims.

Implement the Tour Packages section with separate package cards and short descriptions for: Katra Vaishno Devi Tour Packages; Kashmir Tour Packages (Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam); Himachal Pradesh Tour Packages (Manali, Shimla, Dharamshala); Leh Ladakh Adventure Tours (Pangong Lake, Nubra Valley); Amritsar Religious Tours (Golden Temple, Wagah Border). Each card must have a “Book Now” CTA that routes to booking via WhatsApp (https://wa.me/919906109003) and/or scrolls to Contact.

Implement the Taxi & Travel Services section listing: Katra Taxi Service, Airport & Railway Pickup and Drop, Local Sightseeing, Family Tours, Honeymoon Packages, Group Tours, and Customized Travel Planning.
Implement the Vehicle Fleet section listing vehicle types (Sedan, SUV, Innova, Tempo Traveller) and emphasizing clean AC vehicles and professional drivers, optionally with icons/visuals.
Implement the Why Choose Us section with clear benefit bullets: Local travel experts, Affordable pricing, Safe travel, 24/7 support, Trusted service.

Implement the Popular Routes section listing: Katra to Srinagar Taxi, Jammu to Katra Pickup, Katra to Amritsar, Katra to Manali, and Leh Ladakh Road Trips. Each route should have a conversion CTA (call and/or WhatsApp).
Implement the Customer Reviews section with realistic-looking 5-star travel service reviews (names/initials, short review text, star rating visuals).
Implement the Travel Gallery section showing images representing Vaishno Devi, Kashmir, Leh Ladakh, Himachal, and travel vehicles; use optimized, responsive images (lazy-loading where appropriate).

Implement the Contact section with the exact business details: Business Name: Maa Bhagwati Tour And Travel; Address: Tea Garden, New Bus Stand, Katra, Jammu and Kashmir, India – 182301; Phone/WhatsApp: +91 9906109003; Email: nakul.vd@gmail.com; include a WhatsApp booking button linking to https://wa.me/919906109003 and embed Google Maps for the location.

Apply on-page SEO best practices for a one-page React site: set an SEO-friendly page title and meta description, include keyword-focused headings and section copy using the keywords “Katra Taxi Service”, “Vaishno Devi Tour Package”, “Best Travel Agency in Katra”, and “Katra to Kashmir Taxi”, ensure a single H1, and add structured data (JSON-LD) for a local business with the provided name, address, phone, and email.

Ensure conversion-focused UI patterns across the page: repeated CTAs (Call/WhatsApp/Book Now) in Hero and at least two additional sections, strong button styling, and a mobile-friendly sticky call bar or equivalent persistent CTA on small screens.

Optimize performance for fast loading: compress/optimize images, avoid unnecessary heavy libraries, use responsive image sizing, and ensure good Lighthouse-style fundamentals (no large layout shifts from images; reasonable initial load).

Adopt and apply a coherent visual theme consistent with a trustworthy, professional travel company (mountains/pilgrimage vibes) using a modern neutral palette (avoid blue/purple), strong typography hierarchy, consistent spacing, and clean card layouts across all sections.

Add the generated image assets to the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the Hero and Travel Gallery sections (and optionally Fleet) without routing image delivery through the backend.

Add a simple contact form to the existing Contact section so visitors can send direct inquiries from the one-page site (in addition to existing Call/WhatsApp/Email contact options). The form must use English user-facing text and include at least: Full Name, Phone/WhatsApp Number, Email (optional), Message, and a Submit button.

Wire the Contact form UI to the backend using the existing actor setup (frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts) and React Query mutation patterns, so submissions are sent to the canister and the UI reflects loading/success/error states.

Replace the business name “Maa Bhagwati Tour And Travel” with the exact new name “Shree Ram Holidays – Tour & Travel Company” across all visible UI surfaces (e.g., top navigation brand text, footer business name/copyright text, and any other section copy that mentions the old business name).

Update all SEO-facing metadata to use the new business name “Shree Ram Holidays – Tour & Travel Company”, including the HTML <title>, meta description/OG/Twitter titles as applicable, and the LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data name field.

Update any accessibility/embedded content strings that reference the old business name (for example, the Google Maps iframe title in the Contact section) to use “Shree Ram Holidays – Tour & Travel Company”.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a fully SEO-optimized one-page travel agency website with conversion-focused design and required sections (Hero, About, Tour Packages, Services, Fleet, Why Choose Us, Popular Routes, Reviews, Gallery, Contact with map)
Add a simple contact form for direct inquiries on the one-page site (in addition to existing contact details/WhatsApp/Call CTAs)

Implement backend support to receive and persist contact form submissions in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo). Store inquiries in stable state so they survive upgrades, and return a success response to the frontend after saving.
Connect the GoDaddy domain (maabagwatitourandtravles.in) to the deployed Internet Computer website (custom domain DNS + domain verification/asset configuration)
Rename the business across the entire website and SEO content to “Shree Ram Holidays – Tour & Travel Company” (replace all instances of Maa Bhagwati Tour And Travel)
